correctness.rationale: The promise yields the n/(n+1)K containment by a literal convex combination. Minkowski–Radon and widths give difference-body inclusion. For every u a frustum at the exact support levels a,-b contains K once disks are large, has centroid m(lambda) computed by explicit polynomial integration, and meets the offcenter condition whenever -b < (n+1)m < a. Its centroid limit can approach min(a/(n+1),(na-b)/(n+1)) from below; therefore upper support matches the hull support in every direction. There are no limit-to-uncounted-body assumptions: only support-function characterization of an intersection of convex bodies. The triangle rational shoelace computation gives 7/9.
